CustomField.description: Dot-delimited path in returned SOQL/provider data containing the document locale. Include the source field in SOQL. Blank or unresolved values default to en-US. Composite paths use the section namespace.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Data field path, not a locale literal. Example: Quote_Offer_Locale__c on a template or Quote.Quote_Offer_Locale__c on a composite. Defaults to en-US.
CustomField.label: Locale Field
